def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    # The full 2-line is the direction marker; translate the other colored
    # object until it is adjacent to that line, then mark its trailing edge 8.
    if any(all(v == 2 for v in row) for row in g):
        axis = next(r for r, row in enumerate(g) if all(v == 2 for v in row))
        cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] not in (2, 4, 8)]
        if not cells:
            return g
        lo, hi = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
        if axis > hi:
            shift = axis - 1 - hi
            trailing = lo + shift - 1
        else:
            shift = axis + 1 - lo
            trailing = hi + shift + 1
        moved = [(r + shift, c, g[r][c]) for r, c in cells]
        for r, c in cells:
            g[r][c] = 4
        for r, c, color in moved:
            g[r][c] = color
        if 0 <= trailing < h:
            g[trailing] = [8] * w
        return g
    axis_col = next((c for c in range(w) if all(g[r][c] == 2 for r in range(h))), None)
    if axis_col is None:
        return g
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] not in (2, 4, 8)]
    if not cells:
        return g
    lo, hi = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
    if axis_col > hi:
        shift = axis_col - 1 - hi
        trailing = lo + shift - 1
    else:
        shift = axis_col + 1 - lo
        trailing = hi + shift + 1
    moved = [(r, c + shift, g[r][c]) for r, c in cells]
    for r, c in cells:
        g[r][c] = 4
    for r, c, color in moved:
        g[r][c] = color
    if 0 <= trailing < w:
        for r in range(h):
            g[r][trailing] = 8
    return g
